exposure: Mode of delivery (cesarean section vs. vaginal delivery)
Maternal hepatitis B virus (HBV) DNA levels
hepatitis B surface antigen-positive pregnant women
cohort: Hepatitis B surface antigen-positive pregnant women
finding: Increasing maternal HBV DNA levels were significantly associated with HBV intrauterine transmission, while cesarean section was associated with a reduced risk of transmission.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was associated with a reduced risk of HBV intrauterine transmission compared to vaginal delivery.
